description: This file contains helper functions for testing commit-graphs in a Git repository. It includes functions to initialize OID cache, compare Git modes with commit-graph enabled/disabled, verify traversal behavior consistency, and read expected commit-graph data.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Initializes OID cache with specified versions.

methods.name: graph_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares Git operations output with commit-graph enabled and disabled to ensure consistency.

methods.name: graph_git_behavior
methods.description: Checks if various Git traversal operations produce the same results with and without commit-graph.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Verifies the commit-graph data matches expected output by reading and comparing.
